text:
People Ops: Quick operational update  we've published a new Emergency Medical Leave playbook and a temporary Paid Leave Top-Up for verified short-term hospitalizations. Link + form: https://redwood.internal/policies/emergency-medical-leave (TL;DR in-thread).

aditya_peopleops: TL;DR please?

People Ops: TL;DR  if you or an immediate family member has an unplanned hospital stay (overnight), Redwood provides: 1) up to 5 days of paid leave top-up (in addition to PTO) to bridge immediate needs, 2) a one-time travel cancellation/return refund up to $500 per incident for last-minute cancellations related to the event, and 3) a manager checklist & return-to-work template. Submit the claim within 21 days. No manager pre-approval required for the top-up. :white_heart:

claire_manager: Is this global? Any country-specific caveats?

People Ops: Global for full-time employees; local law may modify paid treatment. The policy page has region notes about taxability and documentation. Contractors not eligible for the top-up but can use the travel refund path if using company-paid travel.

zot_dev: What counts as "immediate family" and what proof is needed?

People Ops: Immediate family = spouse/partner, child, parent, sibling, or legal guardian per the HR definition. We require hospital admission confirmation (scan or provider email) or discharge summary; you can redact sensitive clinical details. A brief one-line explanation is fine for initial claims.

benefits_bot: Filing tip: use GL code EML-TOPUP for the top-up and TRV-CXL for travel refunds. Attach admission confirmation + any travel receipts. For travel refunds, include the cancellation confirmation and proof of payment.

zot_dev: Does the top-up reduce future PTO balance?

People Ops: No  the top-up is a separate paid supplement, not a PTO advance. It will be recorded as "EML-topup" in payroll and does not reduce your PTO bank. If we need to recover overpayment for any reason, payroll will contact the employee before any deduction.

claire_manager: How should managers handle project coverage? Any standard language we should give to teams?

People Ops: Manager one-pager has a three-step checklist: 1) ack the situation and confirm coverage plan; 2) identify an interim owner and document handoff in the team tracker; 3) schedule a 15-min sync for reentry planning when the employee is ready. One-pager linked on the policy page. Managers can request People Ops support for complicated coverage via the manager support form.

payroll_bot: Tax note: the top-up may be taxable in some jurisdictions. We'll include a region-specific tax summary in the claim confirmation; payroll will handle withholding as required.

aditya_peopleops: Retro claims? We had a hospitalization in Dec and didn't file.

People Ops: We're accepting retroactive claims back to 2025-09-01 for qualifying events. Please submit the admission confirmation and travel receipts if applicable. We may follow up to verify dates.

zot_dev: Can travel refunds be used to cover hotel cancellation fees too?

People Ops: Yes  travel refunds cover reasonable non-refundable travel and lodging change/cancellation fees when directly caused by the qualifying medical event. Itemize each expense in the form.

tara_research: We have a caregiver support partner listed somewhere?

People Ops: Yes  the policy page lists vetted caregiver and short-term home support vendors. If you need immediate help coordinating childcare or eldercare while you're out, use the vendor portal link; they can often source same-day coverage.

aditya_peopleops: Privacy reminder: employees can flag claims as "confidential"; docs go to restricted HR access only. Use redaction for sensitive notes.

ops_bot: Published: https://redwood.internal/policies/emergency-medical-leave  Form: https://redwood.internal/forms/eml-claim. Manager one-pager and FAQ attached. Drop-in Q&A next Tues 11am PT in #people-ops-calendar.

claire_manager: Thanks  can People Ops share an example email managers can send to teams when someone's out? Saves time.

People Ops: Yes  template included in the manager one-pager. We'll also circulate a short set of suggested Slack phrasing for sensitive notifications.

tara_research: One more: mental health hospitalization? Covered?

People Ops: Covered  medical necessity is what matters. You do not need to disclose diagnosis in the initial claim. For sensitive cases, DM People Ops and well coordinate privately.

People Ops: Thanks all  if you have an urgent case now DM People Ops with subject "EMERGENCY-LEAVE" and well triage within 24 hours. :sparkles:
